title: WPA2-AP key install (M3) ladder - design only, NOT FIRED by this lane
preconditions: fresh golden boot: page 0x86807FEF/7/2/0xABCD, mask 0, staging 0
attended session with the recovery door READY (tools/recovery-card.sh)
module params recorded before the fire; one module load per boot

fixtures.wpa2: wifi-image-polish rootfs/etc/hostapd-wpa2.conf (WPA2-PSK/CCMP, rekey off for the first rung)

rungs.name: golden-boot control (open AP)
rungs.purpose: prove the boot + AP-start baseline is unchanged by the key patch
steps: insmod hi5622_wifi wpa_keys=0 allow_frames=32 h2d_send_budget=10 hcc_trace=1
run the C2 ctx-create ladder, then hostapd with the OPEN fixture
record: ap rung rc, AP-ENABLED, page/mask, cfg80211_status

rungs.name: fail-closed proof (wpa_keys=0 + WPA2 hostapd)
rungs.purpose: prove the new path never writes a device register when disabled
steps: insmod hi5622_wifi wpa_keys=0 allow_frames=32 h2d_send_budget=10 hcc_trace=1
C2, then hostapd with the WPA2 fixture
pass: start_ap posts the 4 AP frames, AP-ENABLED
hostapd reports the key-install failure (-EOPNOTSUPP), AP stays in the old open-only state
page golden, mask 0, no exception; out[0] consumed
fail_if: page/mask changes or an exception is reported

rungs.name: PRIMARY: WPA2 group-key install at AP startup
rungs.purpose: clear the M3 blocker: hostapd installs the GTK via cfg80211 add_key/set_default_key
steps: insmod hi5622_wifi wpa_keys=1 wpa_key_module=0 allow_frames=32 h2d_send_budget=10 hcc_trace=1
C2, then hostapd with the WPA2 fixture (no client needed)
watch dmesg: AP-start 4 frames, AP-ENABLED, then key_add, then key_default
record cfg80211_status and hostapd liveness for >=120 s
expect_dmesg: cfg80211: start_ap sequence frame 2/4 'ap_cfg' posted (g0 carrier)
cfg80211: add_key posted (g0 id1 cmd 0x0078 'key_add', 96 B, module=0 idx=1 pairwise=0 cipher=0x000fac04 class=data key_len=16 seq_len=0) - firmware worker CA 0x0A5825 installs the key
cfg80211: set_default_key posted (g0 id1 cmd 0x0079 'key_default', 68 B, module=0 idx=1 uni=0 multi=1) - firmware worker CA 0x0A5C9D selects the default key
hostapd: no 'Failed to set key' / 'Failed to set beacon parameters' after the key lines
pass: exactly one key_add (96 B) and one key_default (68 B) announce consumed
cfg80211_status: wpa_keys=1, add_ok=1, def_ok=1, del_ok=0, last_op=set_default_key, last_errno=0
page 0x86807FEF golden, mask 0, no exception, stale-VAP readback unchanged
fail_if: post refused (budget/gap/phase/out[0]) -> record the exact refusal line
page/mask abnormal, H2D lane closed, or firmware exception -> STOP, power-cycle
hostapd still reports a key error after both posts -> capture hostapd -dd log
optional_readback: firmware key-table manager at module_ctx+0x4b8 (requires the bench-proven module_ctx+0x190 readback recipe from wifi-ap-start)
user+0x310 = cipher low byte (0x04 CCMP), user+0x311 = default key index 1
user key cache slot stride 0x3c at user+0x58 (cipher, key_len, seq_len, key[32], seq[16])
this readback is optional evidence; never required to pass R2

rungs.name: BLOCKED-BY-RX: pairwise PTK (4-way handshake)
rungs.purpose: document the next gate honestly, do not attempt to fake it
steps: requires a real client association -> mgmt RX (assoc) + EAPOL RX/TX, both absent (0 RX captures)
when the RX path exists: 4-way M4 triggers NEW_KEY pairwise key_idx=0 MAC=STA (cmd 0x0078, pairwise=1) then DEL_KEY on deauth (cmd 0x007A)
rungs.status: expected to fail at association today; a posted pairwise add_key would be refused by the firmware user lookup for an unknown MAC (record the refusal, no retry)

rungs.name: teardown/soak observation
rungs.purpose: confirm no new leak or hot-path regression
steps: hostapd kill -> stop_ap control path (user_del g0 id9)
60-minute soak sampler (wifi-stability soak tooling) alongside the AP
if a key_del is emitted during teardown, record it (expected only for a known STA)
pass: no new dmesg noise class from the key path when idle
page/mask stable across the soak; hostapd count stable

abort_policy: any page != 0x86807FEF or mask != 0 -> stop, capture, power-cycle (never rmmod after release)
H2D lane closed / timeout -> stop; do not retry the same frame in the same boot
no bench link / recovery door not READY -> no fire
